[[File:Selena Gomez - Walmart Soundcheck Concert.jpg|180px|thumbnail|[[Selena Gomez]] is the most followed individual on Instagram, surpassing 100 million followers on September 25, 2016.]]

This '''list of most followed users on Instagram''' contains the top 50 accounts with the most followers on the social photo-sharing platform [[Instagram]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://socialblade.com/instagram/top/100/followers|title=Top 100 Instagram Users by Followers- Socialblade Instagram Stats {{!}} Instagram Statistics|work=Socialblade|accessdate=September 25, 2016}}</ref> As of {{date|today|mdy}}, the most followed user is [[Instagram]]'s own account, with over 200 million followers. [[Justin Bieber]] formerly had one of the most followed Instagram accounts, with over 77 million followers, until he deleted his page in August 2016.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.vanityfair.com/style/2016/08/justin-bieber-deletes-instagram-selena-gomez|title=Justin Bieber Deletes His Instagram Account in Wake of Selena Gomez Feud|work=[[Vanity Fair (magazine)|Vanity Fair]]|date=August 16, 2016|accessdate=November 10, 2016}}</ref>
